title: Rust: CCP2 codecs and fail-closed admission
description:
Implement wire.12 in rust/lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs, rust/lichen-core/src/announce.rs and applicable parsing/building in rust/lichen-rpl/src/message.rs. Preserve distinct policy, PHY, plan/version, generation, SFN, SCHC and signature namespaces. Bind accepted schedules and commitments to authenticated ownership and validity. Legacy or incompatible advertisements cannot activate CCP2, and rejected inputs cannot partially update active state.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse current codecs, slot-map writer and signature interfaces. Coordinate b7z9.74 through the new signaling leaf rust.09 rather than duplicating field ownership or adding old-roll-up edges. No invented allocation, SCHC-rule repurposing or signature-domain change is permitted. Do not edit audited OSCORE/EDHOC internals, identity derivation or key portability; no hardware or on-air activation is authorized.
acceptance_criteria: Use vectors.02's independent encoded/signed objects through production parsers, builders and admission. Verify exact bytes, truncation, bounds, duplicate/unknown fields, incompatible revision, wrong root/DODAG/generation, expiry and unchanged rejection state. Exercise existing core beacon/Announce tests, rust/lichen-rpl/tests/ccp_beacon_sig_gate.rs and relevant parser fuzz entry points. Run relevant test features, core no-default-feature checks, fmt and clippy; do not accept encode/decode self-round-trips as the oracle.
